title: VTG PLAYBOY MAGAZINE March 1993 Complete With Centerfold Mimi Rogers Laura Dern
descriptionText: The product is a vintageMarch 1993 issue of Playboy magazine, featuring Mimi Rogers and Laura Dern on the centerfold. This magazine was published by American Media Inc in the United States. With a monthly publication frequency, it contains articles, interviews, and images relevant to popular culture, entertainment, and lifestyle topics from that time period, making it a collectible item for fans of vintage magazines or Playboyl enthusiasts.
